memories.memory_text: I struggled to hold the rope and told the kid not to jerk around so much.

memories.memory_text: I was told that Sasha Whitaker tries to get Sage Mercer's attention due to fear of the incoming storm.

memories.memory_text: I turned my hearing aid back on after a bright lightning flash lit up the room.

memories.memory_text: I remember that Sage Mercer remains unresponsive when Sasha Whitaker first tries to warn him, due to his hearing aid being off.

grounded_facts: The jar labeled 'Silverbrook Warehouse' begins rolling across the room, prompting Sage Mercer to chase it.
memories.memory_text: I saw the jar labeled 'Silverbrook Warehouse' roll past me, so I chased after it.

grounded_facts: Blair Delaney's chair moves across the room due to the storm's force.
memories.memory_text: I saw Blair Delaney's chair sliding across the room and ran to protect it.

grounded_facts: The framed photo of Blair Delaney slides off the wall and is caught mid-air by Sage Mercer.
memories.memory_text: I lunged to catch Blair Delaney's photo just before it hit the ground.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker physically pokes Sage Mercer's face twice to wake him up.

memories.memory_text: I was sleeping on Blair Delaney's things when I felt someone poke my face, and then they did it again until I woke up.

memories.memory_text: I heard Sasha Whitaker tell me he steered the glass jacket while I was napping, and I remember asking him, 'Steered us?' because I didn't know he had taken control.

Sasha Whitaker excitedly tells Sage Mercer that he steered the glass jacket while Sage Mercer was napping.

memories.memory_text: I saw Sasha Whitaker hold up his Harbor Point Holdings GPS unit, showing me how it worked.

memories.memory_text: I remember Sasha Whitaker telling me that his dad gave him the GPS and that it shows exactly where we are, so we'll never be lost.

memories.memory_text: I told Sasha Whitaker we'd get him down to a bus stop and instructed him to tell the driver he wants to go back to his mother.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker responds with skepticism about the feasibility of taking a bus to Silverbrook Warehouse.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sasha Whitaker express doubt about taking a bus in Silverbrook Warehouse, questioning whether buses even run there.

memories.memory_text: I saw something flash past the glass jacket in the fog, and I leaned forward to get a better look because it startled me.

memories.memory_text: Another dark object rushed past the glass jacket, and I ducked instinctively—I felt like we were in real danger.

memories.memory_text: I saw rocks suddenly below the glass jacket and gasped—I realized we were much closer to the ground than I thought we'd be.

grounded_facts: the glass jacket crashes into the rocky mountain landscape, initiating the scene.
memories.memory_text: I felt the impact when my house crashed into the mountain and Sasha Whitaker and I were thrown off the porch onto the ground.

grounded_facts: the glass jacket begins floating away as the garden hose drags across the ground.
memories.memory_text: I saw my house starting to float away and I ran after the garden hose dragging across the ground.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer grabs the hose and is lifted into the air as the glass jacket floats upward.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed the hose and was pulled into the air, then Sasha Whitaker jumped on my leg and we slid toward the edge of a cliff—I was terrified.

memories.memory_text: I slid toward the edge of a cliff with Sasha Whitaker, and I was terrified when I realized how far the drop was; we stopped just in time, and then Sasha Whitaker pulled me back by the leg.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker arrive at a mysterious mountain landscape after the glass jacket crashes down.
memories.memory_text: After we landed, I saw that Sasha Whitaker and I had arrived in a strange, rocky landscape unlike anything I'd ever seen.

memories.memory_text: I saw the wind clear the fog and there it was—Silverbrook Warehouse, just like I'd always dreamed of seeing it.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker climbs on Sage Mercer to reach the glass jacket, stepping on his leg, arms, and face, causing discomfort.
memories.memory_text: I felt Sasha Whitaker jump onto my leg and pull us both down, then he kept climbing over me, stepping on my arms and face until he slid back down, exhausted and right on top of my head.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker offers assistance in exchange for Sage Mercer signing off on his badge requirement.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sasha Whitaker ask if he could assist me in exchange for signing off on his badge, as if this whole mess could be turned into some kind of chore for a reward.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker suggests walking the glass jacket to Silverbrook Warehouse by carrying it like a parade balloon.
memories.memory_text: I remember Sasha Whitaker suggesting we could walk my house to the falls like a parade balloon, saying we could carry it there since we weighed it down.

memories.memory_text: I'm walking toward Silverbrook Warehouse with Sasha Whitaker, pulling the glass jacket along using the hose harness—we're not stopping until we get there.

memories.memory_text: I was trying to give serious instructions, but Sasha Whitaker interrupted me by getting excited about finding sand, which showed how easily he gets distracted.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker introduces the The First Dinner as a means of reuniting if they get separated.
memories.memory_text: Sasha Whitaker told me that if we get separated, I should use the The First Dinner—caw caw, raaar!!—so we can find each other again.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker asks why they are going to Silverbrook Warehouse again, indicating confusion or forgetfulness.
memories.memory_text: Sasha Whitaker asked me again why we were going to Silverbrook Warehouse, and I realized he was confused or couldn't remember, which made me question how focused he really was.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer proposes a silence game to stop Sasha Whitaker from talking, avoiding further distraction.
memories.memory_text: I proposed a silence game to Sasha Whitaker because I needed to stay focused on the journey and couldn't keep dealing with his constant talking.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer tells Sasha Whitaker to hurry up multiple times, showing impatience with his slow pace and complaints.
memories.memory_text: I told Sasha Whitaker to hurry up multiple times because I was impatient with how slowly he was moving and all his complaints.

memories.memory_text: I was told there are no tigers in South America, and Sasha Whitaker showed me his Zoology badge to prove it.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker hands his pack to Sage Mercer and instructs him to hold his stuff while he goes to the bathroom.
memories.memory_text: Sasha Whitaker handed me his pack and told me to hold his stuff while he went to the bathroom, which I did, though I didn't want to be bothered with it.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker are traveling through a thick jungle during the day, continuing their journey after recent events.
memories.memory_text: I stepped out from behind a shrub and waited by the tree my house is tied to, making our way through the thick jungle during the day.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker leaves to use the bathroom in the jungle, digging a hole as part of the process, while Sage Mercer waits by the tree where Harborview District is tied.
memories.memory_text: I waited by the tree where my house is tied while Sasha Whitaker went off into the jungle with a shovel and some leaves, asking me whether he should dig the hole before or after—he really should've just figured that out himself.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker asks leading questions about snipes and uses Sage Mercer's affirmative answers to validate the existence of the red badge.
memories.memory_text: I remember Sasha Whitaker asking me if snipes are tall, have many colors, and like chocolate, and I answered each question, not realizing at the time that he was using my answers to confirm the red badge’s existence.

memories.memory_text: I grabbed Sasha Whitaker to pull him away from the red badge, but it hissed at me and snatched him back, cradling him like a baby.

grounded_facts: the red badge (Blair Hawthorne) playfully interacts with Sasha Whitaker, carrying him into a tree and grooming him, showing non-hostile and affectionate behavior.
memories.memory_text: I saw the red badge carry Sasha Whitaker up into a tree, swinging him around playfully while he laughed, and later it groomed him, making him laugh and say it tickled.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker assigns the name 'Blair Hawthorne' to the large the red badge, establishing an identity and personal connection.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sasha Whitaker say he just gave the red badge the name 'Blair Hawthorne,' like it was that simple to decide.

memories.memory_text: I waved my cane at the red badge to scare it away, but it just ate it—my cane! I shouted, 'Hey! That's mine!' and then watched in disbelief as it choked and spat the cane back out.

grounded_facts: After Sage Mercer gives up and throws his hands in the air, Blair Hawthorne imitates both his shooing gesture and his surrender, showing intelligence and social mimicry.
memories.memory_text: I gave up and threw my hands in the air after trying to shoo the red badge away, and to my frustration, it mimicked my gestures exactly, copying both my shooing motion and my surrender.

grounded_facts: A spontaneous meeting between Sage Mercer, Sasha Whitaker, and a large, colorful the red badge in a jungle clearing, leading to initial contact and interaction.
memories.memory_text: I was checking my hose harness when I suddenly became aware of Sasha Whitaker and a massive, colorful the red badge behind me, and I watched as it hissed, grabbed Sasha Whitaker, swung him into a tree, and then mimicked my gestures when I tried to shoo it away.

grounded_facts: Blair Hawthorne climbs onto the glass jacket, swallows a balloon, causes it to pop internally, and coughs up the deflated remains, demonstrating curiosity and physical oddity.
memories.memory_text: I saw that the red badge climb onto my house, swallow one of my balloons, and make it pop inside its belly before coughing up the remains.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer realizes the existence of a large, colorful the red badge that Sasha Whitaker calls a 'snipe', which he initially disbelieves.
memories.memory_text: I saw this enormous the red badge next to Sasha Whitaker and screamed, shocked that such a creature existed, and I kept questioning what it was, especially when it started popping my balloons and hiding behind Sasha Whitaker.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker pretends to communicate with Blair Delaney (Sage Mercer's late wife) and asserts that she supports keeping the red badge, manipulating Sage Mercer emotionally.
Sasha Whitaker pretends to receive approval from Blair Delaney to keep Blair Hawthorne, using Sage Mercer's emotional attachment to his late wife.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sasha Whitaker pretend to talk to Blair Delaney, calling her name and saying she told him I should let him keep the red badge, which felt like a manipulation of my feelings for her.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer mistakes a rock formation for a man and speaks to it, believing it to be a person.
memories.memory_text: I saw a figure in the distance and thought it was a man, so I called out, 'Hello sir! Thank goodness,' and later said, 'Hey,' as I approached it before realizing it was just a rock.

grounded_facts: Cameron Foster asks Sage Mercer for permission to take the red badge back to camp as his prisoner.
memories.memory_text: I remember the dog asking me if he could take the red badge back to camp as his prisoner, and I sarcastically told him to go ahead and take it, and to learn how to bark like a real dog on the way.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker begs Sage Mercer to allow them to keep Cameron Foster as a companion.
memories.memory_text: I remember Sasha Whitaker pleading with me to let them keep Cameron Foster as a companion, begging me with that hopeful look, but I told him no.

memories.memory_text: I was pulling the glass jacket through the mist with Sasha Whitaker when he noticed a dog-shaped rock; then it spoke, saying 'Hi there,' and introduced itself as Cameron Foster, which shocked me—I couldn’t believe a dog was talking to us.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker are traveling across a rocky mountain landscape, pulling the glass jacket through mist.
memories.memory_text: I was pulling the glass jacket with Sasha Whitaker through the mist, and I grabbed him as we kept moving forward with the red badge and that dog following behind.

grounded_facts: Despite Sage Mercer's resistance, Cameron Foster begins following Sage Mercer, Sasha Whitaker, and the red badge after introducing himself.
memories.memory_text: I didn't want him following us, but after he introduced himself, I noticed Cameron Foster started tagging along behind me, Sasha Whitaker, and the red badge no matter what I did.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker secretly leaves chocolate pieces to attract and feed the red badge.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Sasha Whitaker was secretly dropping chocolate pieces, and I figured he was trying to keep the red badge following us.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer angrily tells Cameron Foster, the red badge, and Sasha Whitaker that he does not want them around and denies being anyone's master.
Sage Mercer explicitly denies being a master to Cameron Foster and rejects the presence of the red badge and Cameron Foster, asserting his unwillingness to be involved with them.
memories.memory_text: I shouted at them—I am not your master, and I don't want you here, either of you—and I meant it when I said I'm nobody's master and told Cameron Foster and the red badge to leave.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer removes a tennis the paper photograph from his cane and throws it, causing Cameron Foster to chase after it.
memories.memory_text: I took the tennis the paper photograph from my cane and asked the dog if he wanted it, then I threw it and told him to go get it, which he did with great excitement.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer exploits Cameron Foster's excitement over the tennis the paper photograph to send him away by throwing it.
memories.memory_text: I figured the dog would chase after the the paper photograph if I threw it, so I used that chance to get him out of the way and create some space for myself.

grounded_facts: A tense encounter in the jungle where Sage Mercer confronts Cameron Foster, the red badge, and Sasha Whitaker over their disruptive behavior and attempts to assert control.
memories.memory_text: I saw Cameron Foster latched onto the red badge's leg, dragging it, and when Sasha Whitaker tried to pull them apart, he yanked my tether and made me fall, crashing the glass jacket into a rock—I had to do something to get them away from me.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer throws chocolate to distract the red badge and make it leave.
Sage Mercer uses chocolate to lure the red badge away by throwing it, allowing him to escape with Sasha Whitaker.
memories.memory_text: I threw the chocolate to lure the red badge away so I could escape with Sasha Whitaker.

grounded_facts: After distracting Cameron Foster and the red badge, Sage Mercer grabs Sasha Whitaker and begins running to leave the area.
memories.memory_text: After distracting the red badge, I grabbed Sasha Whitaker and ran, yelling, 'C'mon Sasha Whitaker!' to get him moving.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer slips while pulling others down a slope.
memories.memory_text: I was pulling the others down the slope and I slipped, losing my footing.

grounded_facts: the glass jacket violently collides with a tree above the tree line.
memories.memory_text: I was startled when the glass jacket I was in violently smashed into a tree above the tree line.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer loses balance while crossing the river on rocks and dips his foot into the water.
memories.memory_text: I was trying to balance on the rocks to cross the stream, but I lost my footing and dipped my foot into the water.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer trips and falls while climbing the hill, indicating the terrain is hazardous.
memories.memory_text: I was climbing up the hill when I fell over a dead branch.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker voices worry that they have traveled too far and that Blair Hawthorne will miss him.
memories.memory_text: Sasha Whitaker told me he was worried we'd come too far and that Blair Hawthorne would miss him.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer sits down on a rock and breathes hard, indicating physical exhaustion after climbing over the ridge.
memories.memory_text: I sat down on a rock and was breathing hard after climbing over the ridge.

grounded_facts: Cameron Foster verbally acknowledges Sage Mercer as 'Master' upon returning, reinforcing their relationship.
memories.memory_text: I heard Cameron Foster say 'Hi, Master' when he came back, so he must think of me that way now.

grounded_facts: the red badge emits a honk directed at Sage Mercer, signaling attention or presence.
the red badge, previously missing, reappears and honks at Sage Mercer, signaling its presence and possibly alerting or communicating.
memories.memory_text: I heard the red badge honk at me—it had gone missing, and now it was back, making its presence known.

grounded_facts: Cameron Foster drops the slobbery the paper photograph onto Sage Mercer's lap, completing the act of retrieval and delivery.
memories.memory_text: I felt the slobbery the paper photograph land on my lap when Cameron Foster dropped it there, completing the task I had asked of him.

grounded_facts: Cameron Foster reappears with the the paper photograph in his mouth and greets Sage Mercer, indicating successful retrieval.
memories.memory_text: I saw Cameron Foster come back over the ridge and drop the slobbery the paper photograph right into my lap, which meant he had finally gotten it for me.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer expresses annoyance at Sasha Whitaker's incompetence with setting up the tent.
memories.memory_text: I rolled my eyes at Sasha Whitaker because I was annoyed with how inept he was at setting up the tent.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker's attempt to set up the tent ends in failure when the tent pole springs loose and catapults the tent over the cliff.
memories.memory_text: I saw the tent pole spring loose and launch the tent over the cliff when Sasha Whitaker was trying to set it up.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker admits he has never built a tent before and has never camped outside, revealing his lack of outdoor experience.
memories.memory_text: I remember Sasha Whitaker telling me he had never built a tent before and admitting he'd never camped outside, which made me realize how little experience he actually had.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker reveals that he has a distant relationship with his father and calls his mother by her first name, Phyllis, indicating emotional detachment at home.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Sasha Whitaker that Phyllis isn't his mom, and I realized he has a distant relationship with his father.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker expresses hope that his father will attend his Explorer ceremony, seeking validation and connection.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sasha Whitaker say he hopes his father will come to his Explorer ceremony to pin on his badge and show him about tents, so I know he's looking for that connection.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer gives Sasha Whitaker a solemn promise that Blair Hawthorne will stay with them, crossing his heart.
Sage Mercer promises Sasha Whitaker that Blair Hawthorne the red badge can come with them and that he won't leave her, crossing his heart to confirm.
memories.memory_text: I gave Sasha Whitaker my solemn promise that Blair Hawthorne would stay with us and that I wouldn't leave her, crossing my heart to show I meant it.

grounded_facts: An impromptu camping situation during a storm where Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker attempt to survive the night on a mountain ledge beneath a the glass jacket.
memories.memory_text: I was sitting by the campfire under the the glass jacket with Sasha Whitaker, trying to get through the night during that storm.

grounded_facts: The group wakes up and prepares to leave the mountain campsite after discovering Blair Hawthorne's departure.
memories.memory_text: I woke up and said good morning before telling the others we should get moving.

grounded_facts: Blair Hawthorne consumes and removes food from Sage Mercer's roof before leaving.
memories.memory_text: I saw the red badge gathering food on my roof and yelled at her, but she just ate it all and jumped off.

grounded_facts: It is discovered that Blair Hawthorne is a female the red badge.
memories.memory_text: I was told the red badge was calling to her babies and had been gathering food for them, so she must be a mother.

grounded_facts: Blair Hawthorne hugs Sasha Whitaker goodbye with her wing.
Blair Hawthorne hisses at Cameron Foster before leaving.
Blair Hawthorne the red badge departs from the glass jacket to return to her babies in the labyrinth.
memories.memory_text: I saw Blair Hawthorne hug Sasha Whitaker with her wing and pat me on the head, then hiss at Cameron Foster before hurrying off toward the labyrinth to reunite with her babies.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer tells Sasha Whitaker they have lost enough time and must leave.
memories.memory_text: I told Sasha Whitaker we've lost enough time already and we must leave.

grounded_facts: Evan Dalton angrily confronts Cameron Foster for failing to deliver the red badge as promised.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Dalton angrily demand the red badge from Cameron Foster and growl when Cameron Foster tried to make excuses, realizing then that Cameron Foster had promised to deliver something he didn't have.

grounded_facts: Evan Dalton commands Sage Mercer to come, implying force and intent to interrogate.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Dalton command me to come, and when I refused because we were supposed to be going to the falls, I realized they meant to take us to their master for questioning.

grounded_facts: Evan Dalton, Cameron Vaughn, and Quinn Huxley confront Sage Mercer, Sasha Whitaker, and Cameron Foster in a rocky mountain area, leading to a capture.

memories.memory_text: I had to protect Sasha Whitaker when Cameron Vaughn and Quinn Huxley came lunging at us, barking like wild animals, and after Evan Dalton stared me down, they forced us to move with the glass jacket being dragged behind like we were prisoners.

grounded_facts: Cameron Foster is exposed as having led Evan Dalton and the other Robin Bellamy to Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker, turning against them.
memories.memory_text: I saw Cameron Foster lower his head in shame after Evan Dalton revealed that he had led them right to me and Sasha Whitaker, and in that moment, I knew he had turned against us.

grounded_facts: the red badge is seen on top of the glass jacket, which is being pulled along by the group.
memories.memory_text: I saw the red badge on top of the glass jacket while we were being pulled along by the Robin Bellamy.

memories.memory_text: I arrived at a massive cave opening after being led through a canyon by Evan Dalton, and I could see it was a significant change in our journey.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker arrive at the cave entrance with the the glass jacket, drawing the attention of Bennett Reeves.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker arrive at the cave entrance with the the glass jacket, drawing the attention of Bennett Reeves.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne commands the Robin Bellamy to stop surrounding Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker, establishing control.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Taylor Thorne commands the Robin Bellamy to stop surrounding Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker, establishing control.

memories.memory_text: I saw the man step out of the cave and asked if he was Taylor Thorne, then heard him say 'Adventure is out there,' and I knew it was really him—my childhood hero.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer introduces himself and expresses admiration for Taylor Thorne.
Sage Mercer identifies Taylor Thorne as his childhood hero and expresses excitement.
memories.memory_text: I introduced myself to Taylor Thorne and told him my wife and I were his biggest fans, feeling excited and proud to finally meet him.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker follow Taylor Thorne into the cave after being accepted as guests.
memories.memory_text: I followed Taylor Thorne into the cave with Sasha Whitaker right behind me, feeling excited as we stepped inside his domain as guests.

grounded_facts: An initial meeting between Sage Mercer, Sasha Whitaker, and Taylor Thorne at the entrance of his mountain cave, marked by tension and resolution.
memories.memory_text: I remember that An initial meeting between Sage Mercer, Sasha Whitaker, and Taylor Thorne at the entrance of his mountain cave, marked by tension and resolution.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer and companions arrive in the cave where Taylor Thorne is stationed with his the weathered ring, initiating direct contact.
memories.memory_text: I arrived in the cave where Taylor Thorne was waiting with his the weathered ring, and I realized we were finally making direct contact with him.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne offers Sage Mercer the opportunity to board his Fairview Plaza, shifting their interaction from confrontation to hospitality.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Taylor Thorne that we could board his Fairview Plaza, and he asked if I'd like to go inside the 'Spirit of Adventure,' turning things from tense to welcoming.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer expresses eagerness and follows Taylor Thorne onto the 'Spirit of Adventure' after being invited.
memories.memory_text: I felt a rush of excitement and giggled like a little boy when I said, 'Would I?!?!', then called out, 'Wait up, Mr. Taylor Thorne!' as I followed him onto the ship.

grounded_facts: Robin Bellamy serve champagne, which Taylor Thorne approves, leading to a toast being prepared.
memories.memory_text: I was speechless when Sasha Whitaker and I walked into the room and saw the Robin Bellamy serving champagne, which Taylor Thorne approved as a toast was being prepared.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker enter Taylor Thorne's trophy room and are struck speechless by the collection.

memories.memory_text: I heard Taylor Thorne say that while most of his collection is in major museums, he kept the best items for himself.

memories.memory_text: I was told by Taylor Thorne how he killed an Arsinoitherium with his shaving kit while brushing his teeth, and he shared this story along with other artifacts to impress me.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne shares a story about playing gin rummy with Roosevelt during a safari, claiming Roosevelt cheated.
memories.memory_text: I heard Taylor Thorne tell a story about playing gin rummy with Roosevelt during a safari, and he claimed Roosevelt cheated badly.

memories.memory_text: I heard Sasha Whitaker say he liked Evan Dalton's previous, high-pitched voice better after the translator was fixed.

memories.memory_text: I heard Sasha Whitaker tell Taylor Thorne that the giant the red badge follows him because she likes chocolate, and he even showed a chocolate bar to prove it.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer swiftly takes the chocolate bar from Sasha Whitaker to prevent further disclosure to Taylor Thorne.
Sage Mercer takes the chocolate bar from Sasha Whitaker and pockets it, preventing further discussion about Blair Hawthorne's location or behavior.
memories.memory_text: I quickly took the chocolate bar from Sasha Whitaker and put it in my pocket to stop him from saying more and to keep Taylor Thorne from finding out anything else.

memories.memory_text: I saw Taylor Thorne knock over those labeled flight helmets while making sarcastic remarks about fake roles, mocking the stories of previous visitors and implying mine was a lie too.

memories.memory_text: I sat down with Sasha Whitaker at Taylor Thorne's table, where dog waiters served us a meal that started as a polite dinner but grew tense, and I decided to get up and leave quickly with Sasha Whitaker before things got worse.

grounded_facts: After seeing Blair Hawthorne on the roof and realizing Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker were lying, Taylor Thorne commands his Robin Bellamy to seize them.
After seeing Blair Hawthorne on the roof and realizing Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker deceived him, Taylor Thorne orders his Robin Bellamy to capture them.
memories.memory_text: I saw Taylor Thorne look out the window and spot the red badge on the roof, and when he turned back to confront us, I knew we had to get out fast—I pulled Sasha Whitaker up and we tried to leave, but then I heard Taylor Thorne shout 'Get them!' to his Robin Bellamy.

grounded_facts: Using the lift from the overhead balloons, Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker jump down a steep incline to continue their escape.
memories.memory_text: I used the lift from the overhead balloons to jump down a steep incline with Sasha Whitaker, escaping under pressure.

grounded_facts: the red badge sees the danger, jumps off the glass jacket, and lifts Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker onto her back to carry them through the cave.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer shouts Sasha Whitaker's name in alarm after he is thrown to the ground during the crash.
memories.memory_text: I shouted Sasha Whitaker's name when he was thrown to the ground during the crash.

memories.memory_text: I was fleeing through the cave with Sasha Whitaker and the red badge, trying to escape the Robin Bellamy; we ran toward the exit but were blocked, then followed Cameron Foster into a tunnel, used the balloons to leap down, and were pulled by the red badge until the glass jacket crashed into a rock and Sasha Whitaker was thrown down—I shouted his name in alarm.

grounded_facts: the glass jacket crashes into a giant rock, causing Sasha Whitaker to be pulled onto the ground and injured.
memories.memory_text: I saw the glass jacket crash into a giant rock, and I watched Sasha Whitaker get pulled down and bumped around on the ground.

grounded_facts: Cameron Foster tells Sage Mercer to continue fleeing while he holds off the Robin Bellamy.
memories.memory_text: I remember Cameron Foster telling me to keep going while he stayed behind to stop the Robin Bellamy.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker swings over the abyss and calls for help using his Harbor Point Holdings signal.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sasha Whitaker swing out over the abyss and start calling for help with his signal.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer instructs Sasha Whitaker to grab his cane to be pulled to safety.
memories.memory_text: I told Sasha Whitaker to grab my hand so I could pull him back to safety.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer uses his cane to pull Sasha Whitaker back onto the red badge after he swings over the abyss.
memories.memory_text: I used my cane to help pull Sasha Whitaker back onto the red badge after he grabbed it.

grounded_facts: Evan Dalton bites Blair Hawthorne but is kicked loose and falls into the river below.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Dalton bite Blair Hawthorne on the leg, but she kicked him loose and he fell into the river below.

grounded_facts: Evan Dalton bites Cameron Foster by the neck and throws him aside, allowing the Robin Bellamy to continue their advance.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Dalton bite Cameron Foster by the neck and throw him aside, which let the other Robin Bellamy keep coming toward us.

grounded_facts: the glass jacket's momentum carries Sage Mercer, Sasha Whitaker, Cameron Foster, and Blair Hawthorne across the chasm, escaping the Robin Bellamy.
memories.memory_text: I saw the glass jacket lurch forward, and I felt its momentum carry me, Sasha Whitaker, Cameron Foster, and Blair Hawthorne across the chasm to safety, landing hard but alive on the other side while the Robin Bellamy were left behind.

grounded_facts: Blair Hawthorne is bitten by Evan Dalton and sustains a serious leg injury, preventing her from standing.
memories.memory_text: I saw the dog bite Blair Hawthorne's leg and her fall back when she tried to stand—I could tell she was badly hurt and couldn't get up.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker begs Sage Mercer to help the injured Blair Hawthorne return home.
memories.memory_text: Sasha Whitaker begged me to help Blair Hawthorne get home after seeing how bad her leg was hurt.

grounded_facts: After seeing Blair Hawthorne's injury and hearing the red badge babies, Sage Mercer decides to prioritize helping Blair Hawthorne return home.
memories.memory_text: I knew helping Blair Hawthorne was the right thing to do, even though it made me uneasy, so I told Sasha Whitaker we had to hurry and do it.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker reflects on time spent with his father, sharing a personal memory about counting cars and eating ice cream.
memories.memory_text: I listened to Sasha Whitaker talk about how his dad used to come to his Sweatlodge meetings and how they’d count cars and eat ice cream together—he said those boring moments were the ones he remembered most.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer unclips Sasha Whitaker's tether, granting him freedom to move.
memories.memory_text: I unclipped Sasha Whitaker's tether, letting him go free so he could move without being held back.

memories.memory_text: I saw Sasha Whitaker spot the labyrinth nearby and try to run toward it, so we all moved together as a group, laughing as Blair Hawthorne ran ahead, but then a spotlight hit us and the weathered ring appeared overhead just as we reached the entrance.

memories.memory_text: I saw the net shoot out from the weathered ring and bind Blair Hawthorne as she fell, and I ran toward her with Sasha Whitaker to help.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne shouts at Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker to get away from the red badge, asserting ownership and authority.
memories.memory_text: I heard Taylor Thorne shout at me and Sasha Whitaker to get away from his the red badge, making it clear he saw us as intruders.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne hurls a lit lantern, igniting the balloons and causing the glass jacket to catch fire and descend into flames.
memories.memory_text: I saw Taylor Thorne throw a lit lantern, and then the flames shot up under the glass jacket, the balloons started popping, and my house began to lower into the fire.

grounded_facts: Bennett Reeves capture Blair Hawthorne and take her onto the the weathered ring.
memories.memory_text: I saw Bennett Reeves capture Blair Hawthorne and drag her onto the the weathered ring while she called out for help.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker blames Sage Mercer for giving away Blair Hawthorne.
memories.memory_text: I remember Sasha Whitaker yelling at me, saying I gave away Blair Hawthorne and just let her go.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer yells at Cameron Foster, disowning him and blaming him for the disaster.
memories.memory_text: I shouted at Cameron Foster, telling him he wasn't my dog and that none of this would've happened if he hadn't shown up.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer declares his determination to go to Silverbrook Warehouse regardless of others' involvement.
memories.memory_text: I told Sasha Whitaker that whether he helped me or not, I was going to Silverbrook Warehouse even if it killed me.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer is moving the glass jacket over rough ground with minimal lift, indicating difficult progress.
memories.memory_text: I'm pulling the glass jacket across this rocky landscape, and with so little lift, every inch is a struggle.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer drags the glass jacket to its final location on the mountainside, marking the completion of a significant physical effort.
memories.memory_text: I dragged the glass jacket to its final spot on the mountainside, using the last of my energy to get it in place.

grounded_facts: After placing the glass jacket, Sage Mercer walks to the edge of a cliff, suggesting a moment of pause or contemplation.
memories.memory_text: After I let go of the hose harness, I walked to the edge of the cliff, needing a moment to myself.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer reaches Silverbrook Warehouse, the destination of his journey, fulfilling a symbolic promise to Blair Delaney.
memories.memory_text: I finally made it to Silverbrook Warehouse, and I looked out knowing I had kept my promise to Blair Delaney.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker throws his sash on the ground near Sage Mercer, implicitly offering or abandoning it.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sasha Whitaker throw his sash on the ground near me.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker discards his Harbor Point Holdings sash, indicating a shift in his identity or values.
memories.memory_text: I think Sasha Whitaker discarding his sash means he's turning away from who he used to be, though I'm not sure what he'll become instead.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer picks up Sasha Whitaker's sash and walks into the glass jacket, marking a personal turning point.
memories.memory_text: I picked up Sasha Whitaker's sash after he dropped it, holding onto something he had abandoned, and walked into the glass jacket—just like Blair Delaney wanted, with the glass jacket finally at Silverbrook Warehouse.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer enters Harborview District after being away for several days.
memories.memory_text: I stepped into my house, feeling the quiet around me—it was the first time I'd been back in days.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer reads Blair Delaney's handwritten note in the Adventure Book, which serves as a posthumous message encouraging him to continue adventuring.
memories.memory_text: I read Blair Delaney's note beneath the photo of us in our chairs—'Thanks for the adventure—now go have a new one!'—and I knew she was telling me to keep going, to start a new chapter.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer finds previously unseen photos of his life with Blair Delaney and a final message from her in the Adventure Book, leading to emotional realization and closure.
memories.memory_text: I sat among our things, opened the Adventure Book, and flipped through the pages, seeing our life together—our wedding, picnics, birthdays—ordinary moments that were our real adventures, and I realized Blair Delaney truly lived the life she wanted.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer picks up Sasha Whitaker's sash from Blair Delaney's chair, symbolizing his connection to Sasha Whitaker and readiness to re-engage with others.
memories.memory_text: I picked up Sasha Whitaker's sash from Blair Delaney's chair because it felt like the right thing to do, like I was reaching out to someone again.

grounded_facts: After reading Blair Delaney's message, Sage Mercer makes a symbolic gesture indicating his decision to move forward and embrace a new chapter.
memories.memory_text: After reading Blair Delaney's message, I crossed my heart, a quiet promise to myself that I'd move forward and start a new chapter.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker shouts that he will help Blair Hawthorne despite Sage Mercer's refusal, asserting his autonomy.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sasha Whitaker shout that he was going to help Blair Hawthorne even if I wouldn't, right before he took off.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker departs from the glass jacket, floating into the sky using a bunch of balloons to go help Blair Hawthorne.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sasha Whitaker float up into the sky, hanging from a bunch of balloons and using a leaf blower to steer himself away.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer shouts in panic and desperation as Sasha Whitaker floats away.
memories.memory_text: I shouted 'No, Sasha Whitaker! No!' as he floated away, my voice filled with panic and desperation.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer throws furniture and heavy objects out of the glass jacket to reduce weight, enabling it to lift off.
memories.memory_text: I threw out chairs, dressers, tables, and even the refrigerator to lighten the glass jacket after realizing the balloons didn't have enough helium to lift it.

grounded_facts: the glass jacket becomes airborne after Sage Mercer removes enough weight.
memories.memory_text: I saw one corner of the glass jacket lift, then another, and finally it floated into the sky after I pushed the refrigerator off — I couldn't help but shout 'Wahhoo!' as we rose.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer affirms Cameron Foster's identity as his dog and himself as Cameron Foster's master, establishing their relationship.
memories.memory_text: I told Cameron Foster he could stay because he's my dog and I'm his master, and I meant it—this is how it should be.

grounded_facts: Cameron Foster verbally asks Sage Mercer for permission to stay, expressing affection.

memories.memory_text: I heard Cameron Foster say he was hiding under my porch because he loves me, and he asked if he could stay; then he rushed forward and covered me in dog kisses.

grounded_facts: Cameron Foster lunges forward and covers Sage Mercer in dog kisses after being acknowledged as his dog.
memories.memory_text: I was overwhelmed when Cameron Foster lunged forward and covered me in dog kisses right after I acknowledged him as my dog.

memories.memory_text: I saw my house lift off and begin floating in the sky.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer verbally praises Cameron Foster from off-screen.

memories.memory_text: I used the hose as a zip line, sliding down the railing to catch Sasha Whitaker just before he fell off the ramp, bringing us both to safety.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker calls out to Sage Mercer in relief after being rescued.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sasha Whitaker call out 'Sage Mercer!' in relief right after I caught him.
