memories.memory_text: I introduced myself as a Harbor Point Holdings and formally offered my help to Sage Mercer by asking if he needed any assistance today.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker's organized effort to earn the Assisting the Elderly badge by finding an elderly person to help, framed as part of his Explorer duties.
memories.memory_text: I'm working hard to earn my Assisting the Elderly badge so I can become a Senior Harbor Point Holdings, and I remember how excited I am about the ceremony where the dads pin on the badges.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker introduces himself as a Harbor Point Holdings and explains his goal of earning the Assisting the Elderly badge to become a Senior Harbor Point Holdings, prompting Sage Mercer to assign him a task.
memories.memory_text: I introduced myself as a Harbor Point Holdings from Tribe 54, Sweatlodge 12, and told Sage Mercer how I'm working to earn my Assisting the Elderly badge so I can become a Senior Harbor Point Holdings.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer tricks Sasha Whitaker into going on a futile search for a fictional the red badge called a snipe, exploiting the boy's eagerness to assist the elderly.
memories.memory_text: I think Sage Mercer might be tricking me somehow—sending me to catch a snipe by clapping three times and going two blocks down—but I’m not totally sure; maybe it’s just a hard task because he said the snipe is crafty.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer fabricates a story about a snipe to trick Sasha Whitaker into leaving.
memories.memory_text: Sage Mercer told me about a snipe, a the red badge with beady eyes that eats his azaleas, and said he’s too elderly and infirm to catch it, so he asked if someone could help him.

grounded_facts: A construction truck accidentally crushes Blair Delaney's mailbox while backing up, triggering Sage Mercer's emotional reaction.
memories.memory_text: I saw the truck backing up too close to Blair Delaney's mailbox, and then it crushed the front of it.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer aggressively objects to the worker touching the damaged mailbox.
memories.memory_text: I shouted at the worker not to touch the mailbox, telling him to get away and leave it alone.

grounded_facts: In a fit of rage over the destruction of Blair Delaney's mailbox, Sage Mercer hits a construction worker with his cane, causing injury.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer hit the worker with his cane, and then the worker fell and was bleeding from his head.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker appears at Sage Mercer's porch after following what he thought was a snipe, which turned out to resemble a large mouse.
memories.memory_text: I thought I found a snipe, so I followed it under the porch, but it looked more like a large mouse, and I lost my flag when it blew off into the clouds.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer refuses to let Sasha Whitaker into the glass jacket and slams the door.
Sage Mercer refuses Sasha Whitaker's request to enter and slams the door.
memories.memory_text: I asked to come in, but Sage Mercer said 'No' and slammed the door on me.

grounded_facts: After reconsidering, Sage Mercer opens the door again and permits Sasha Whitaker to come inside.
Sage Mercer changes his mind and allows Sasha Whitaker to enter the glass jacket.
memories.memory_text: I waited outside, and then Sage Mercer changed his mind and let me come inside, so I ran in.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker asks Sage Mercer to let him in after following a creature under the porch.
memories.memory_text: I introduced myself to Sage Mercer and asked him to let me in, hoping he'd say yes.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer takes the engraved page from Sasha Whitaker and pockets it to protect it from being soiled.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer take the engraved page from my hands and put it in his pocket.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer scolds Sasha Whitaker for handling the atlas page, expressing concern over its preservation.
memories.memory_text: Sage Mercer told me not to touch the atlas page because I might soil it.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker comments on and asks about Sage Mercer's unconventional method of traveling with Harborview District.
memories.memory_text: I commented on how I'd never been in a the glass jacket before, then asked Sage Mercer if he was going on a trip and if he was heading to South America, because I noticed he wasn't flying like most people do.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker manipulates the steering rig, causing the glass jacket to tilt and Sage Mercer to be thrown off balance.
memories.memory_text: I steered the rig and felt the glass jacket tilt, throwing Sage Mercer off balance.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer tells Sasha Whitaker to stop manipulating the steering rig after the glass jacket begins to tilt.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sage Mercer yell at me to stop messing with the steering rig after the glass jacket started moving.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker finds Blair Delaney's drawing in the open atlas and comments on the destination, initiating curiosity about Sage Mercer's journey.
memories.memory_text: I found Blair Delaney's drawing in the open atlas and looked out the front window, wondering about Silverbrook Warehouse as the destination of Sage Mercer's journey.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker comments that the building is so close he could almost touch it, prompting Sage Mercer's idea.
memories.memory_text: I commented that the building was so close I could almost touch it, and then Sage Mercer had an idea.

grounded_facts: In Sage Mercer's daydream, Sasha Whitaker reports seeing a bus and the glass jacket from below.
memories.memory_text: I looked down and saw a bus that could take me home, so I called out to Sage Mercer about it, and then I noticed I could see Harborview District from where I was.

grounded_facts: In the daydream, Sage Mercer struggles to hold the rope and warns Sasha Whitaker to stop jerking around.
memories.memory_text: I was moving around while on the rope, and I heard Sage Mercer tell me not to jerk around so much because he was struggling to hold on.

grounded_facts: After the failed daydream, Sage Mercer concludes that lowering Sasha Whitaker on a rope is not a viable plan.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sage Mercer say, 'Well, that's not gonna work,' after his daydream, so I knew he didn't think lowering me on a rope was a good plan.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker tries to get Sage Mercer's attention due to fear of the incoming storm.
memories.memory_text: I tried to get Sage Mercer's attention because I was scared of the incoming storm and needed him to listen to me.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer remains unresponsive when Sasha Whitaker first tries to warn him, due to his hearing aid being off.
memories.memory_text: I tried to get Sage Mercer's attention because the storm was getting scary, but he didn't respond to me at all.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker attempts to warn Sage Mercer about the approaching dangerous storm.
memories.memory_text: I tried to warn Sage Mercer about the big storm coming because I could see it getting scary and I was afraid we'd get blown to bits—we were in real trouble.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer turns off his hearing aid to block out sound, creating silence.
memories.memory_text: I think Sage Mercer had turned off his hearing aid on purpose to block out sound, because he only reacted after he turned it back on.

grounded_facts: After a lightning flash, Sage Mercer turns his hearing aid back on.
memories.memory_text: After a bright lightning flash lit up the room, I saw Sage Mercer finally turn his hearing aid back on.

grounded_facts: A severe storm with lightning begins to hit near the glass jacket while he and Sasha Whitaker are inside.
memories.memory_text: I saw the storm start to hit near the glass jacket, and lightning began flashing outside, making everything feel dangerous.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker draws Sage Mercer's attention to the cumulonimbus clouds visible from the window.
memories.memory_text: I pointed out the cumulonimbus clouds to Sage Mercer, telling him to look at the sky and see the weather change coming.

grounded_facts: The jar labeled 'Silverbrook Warehouse' begins rolling across the room, prompting Sage Mercer to chase it.
The framed photo of Blair Delaney slides off the wall and is caught mid-air by Sage Mercer.
Blair Delaney's chair moves across the room due to the storm's force.
memories.memory_text: I saw my backpack start sliding toward the open door and screamed—I thought I was going to lose it, and I remember how everything was moving during the storm, like the jar, Blair Delaney's chair, and her photo almost falling, and I had to act fast to keep my stuff safe.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker jumps on his sliding backpack to prevent it from escaping, narrowly avoiding being swept out the door.
memories.memory_text: I saw my backpack sliding toward the open door and yelled 'My pack!'—then I jumped on it and shouted 'Got ya!' as I held on, barely avoiding getting swept out when the door slammed shut.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker physically pokes Sage Mercer's face twice to wake him up.
Sage Mercer is poked awake by Sasha Whitaker after sleeping on Blair Delaney's belongings.
memories.memory_text: I poked Sage Mercer's face twice to wake him up, and he finally stirred after sleeping on Blair Delaney's things.

grounded_facts: A morning event in Sage Mercer's living room where Sage Mercer is woken and informed that Sasha Whitaker steered the glass jacket.
memories.memory_text: After I woke Sage Mercer, I told him I had steered the glass jacket while he was napping, and that I did it after he tied everything down.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker announces that he took control of steering the glass jacket while Sage Mercer was napping.
Sasha Whitaker excitedly tells Sage Mercer that he steered the glass jacket while Sage Mercer was napping.
memories.memory_text: I excitedly told Sage Mercer that I steered the glass jacket while he was napping, and I announced that I took control to show him what I did.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker shows Sage Mercer his Harbor Point Holdings GPS unit, explaining that it helps them know their exact location in South America.
Sasha Whitaker tells Sage Mercer that the GPS, a gift from his dad, shows their exact location, emphasizing they'll never be lost.
memories.memory_text: I showed Sage Mercer my Harbor Point Holdings GPS, telling him it was a gift from my dad and that it shows exactly where we are on the planet, so we'll never be lost.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker accidentally throws the GPS unit out the window while gesturing, causing it to be lost.
memories.memory_text: I accidentally threw the GPS out the window while gesturing, and I realized I’d lost it.

grounded_facts: The GPS device is dropped and falls into the clouds, making it unrecoverable.
memories.memory_text: I watched the GPS unit fall into the clouds and knew it was gone for good.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer begins cutting the strings of the balloons, indicating a decision to release them.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer kneel by the fireplace and start cutting the balloon strings.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer tells Sasha Whitaker how to return home via bus, showing care and planning for his safety.
memories.memory_text: Sage Mercer told me we'd find a bus stop and that I should tell the driver I want to go back to my mother.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker responds with skepticism about the feasibility of taking a bus to Silverbrook Warehouse.
memories.memory_text: I responded to Sage Mercer by saying I don't think they have buses in Silverbrook Warehouse, doubting his plan would work.

grounded_facts: the glass jacket begins to lower down into the fog, marking a change in its position and setting.
memories.memory_text: I saw the glass jacket begin to lower into the fog, marking a change in its position and setting.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker reacts verbally to the glass jacket descending, noting the difficulty of getting back to Harborview District.
memories.memory_text: I reacted out loud to the glass jacket descending, saying it was going to take a billion transfers to get back to my house.

grounded_facts: the glass jacket, lifted by balloons, begins descending through thick clouds, indicating a change in altitude and potential proximity to terrain.
memories.memory_text: I was on the porch with Sage Mercer when I saw the glass jacket start moving down into thick, dark clouds, and I realized we were descending quickly.

grounded_facts: An unidentified dark object flashes past the glass jacket, startling Sage Mercer and prompting him to lean forward in concern.
memories.memory_text: I saw something flash by us in the fog, and Sage Mercer immediately leaned forward, which startled me.

grounded_facts: Another dark object rushes past the glass jacket, causing Sage Mercer to duck defensively, signaling escalating danger.
memories.memory_text: Another dark object whooshed past us, and I saw Sage Mercer duck, which made me feel like we were in real danger.

grounded_facts: the glass jacket crashes into the rocky mountain landscape, initiating the scene.
Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker arrive at a mysterious mountain landscape after the glass jacket crashes down.
memories.memory_text: I crashed with Sage Mercer when the glass jacket slammed into the mountain and we were thrown onto the ground.

grounded_facts: the glass jacket begins floating away as the garden hose drags across the ground.
memories.memory_text: I saw the glass jacket start floating away and he ran after the garden hose dragging across the ground.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer grabs the hose and is lifted into the air as the glass jacket floats upward.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer grab the hose and get pulled into the air, so I jumped onto his leg to help bring him back down.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker slide toward a cliff edge but stop before falling; Sasha Whitaker pulls Sage Mercer back.
memories.memory_text: I remember sliding toward the cliff edge with Sage Mercer, the drop just feet away, and seeing the fear in his eyes—we stopped just in time, and I pulled him back by the leg to safety.

grounded_facts: The fog clears to reveal Silverbrook Warehouse in the distance; Sage Mercer recognizes it as his lifelong destination.
memories.memory_text: I was standing with Sage Mercer as the wind picked up and we struggled against it; then the fog cleared and I saw the crescent-shaped mountain we were on, and across the distance, ten miles away, Silverbrook Warehouse appeared.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker climbs on Sage Mercer to reach the glass jacket, stepping on his leg, arms, and face, causing discomfort.
memories.memory_text: I climbed on Sage Mercer, stepping on his leg, arms, and face to try to reach the glass jacket, but it was hard and he seemed uncomfortable.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker offers assistance in exchange for Sage Mercer signing off on his badge requirement.
memories.memory_text: I asked Sage Mercer if I could assist him in exchange for signing off on my badge, hoping he'd agree.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker suggests walking the glass jacket to Silverbrook Warehouse by carrying it like a parade balloon.
memories.memory_text: I suggested we could walk Harborview District to Silverbrook Warehouse like a parade balloon, and I felt excited when he started considering it.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker begin walking toward Silverbrook Warehouse, connected to the the glass jacket by a hose harness.
memories.memory_text: I was walking with Sage Mercer toward Silverbrook Warehouse, pulling the glass jacket along with us through the hose harness.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker interrupts Sage Mercer's serious instructions by excitedly pointing out sand, showing his distractibility.
memories.memory_text: I got excited and pointed out the sand to Sage Mercer, shouting 'Sand!' and 'I found sand!' because I was so happy about it.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker introduces the The First Dinner as a means of reuniting if they get separated.
memories.memory_text: I introduced the The First Dinner to Sage Mercer in case we get separated—caw caw, raaar!!

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker asks why they are going to Silverbrook Warehouse again, indicating confusion or forgetfulness.
memories.memory_text: I asked Sage Mercer why we were going to Silverbrook Warehouse again because I wasn't sure about the reason.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer proposes a silence game to stop Sasha Whitaker from talking, avoiding further distraction.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Sage Mercer that we should play a quiet game where we see who can stay silent the longest, so I knew he wanted me to stop talking.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer tells Sasha Whitaker to hurry up multiple times, showing impatience with his slow pace and complaints.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sage Mercer tell me to hurry up multiple times, yelling at me because he was impatient with how slowly I was moving and that the tigers would eat me if I didn't.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker informs Sage Mercer that there are no tigers in South America, using his 'Zoology' badge as proof.
memories.memory_text: I told Sage Mercer there are no tigers in South America, and I showed him my Zoology badge to prove it.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker hands his pack to Sage Mercer and instructs him to hold his stuff while he goes to the bathroom.
memories.memory_text: I handed my pack to Sage Mercer and told him to hold my stuff while I went to the bathroom.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker leaves to use the bathroom in the jungle, digging a hole as part of the process, while Sage Mercer waits by the tree where Harborview District is tied.
memories.memory_text: I went into the jungle with my shovel and some leaves to dig a hole and use the bathroom, while Sage Mercer waited by the tree where Harborview District was tied.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker are traveling through a thick jungle during the day, continuing their journey after recent events.
memories.memory_text: I was exhausted and struggling to keep moving through the thick jungle during the day, so I lay down in the dirt and showed Sage Mercer my badge to make a point before finally getting up and heading into the shrubs.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker notices animal tracks in the jungle and identifies them as belonging to a snipe.
memories.memory_text: I was about to head back to Sage Mercer when I spotted some tracks in the jungle, and I realized they were snipe tracks.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker offers chocolate to the snipe to gain its trust and encourage it to come out.
memories.memory_text: I offered my chocolate to the snipe, holding it out gently so it would feel safe and come out, because I wanted to gain its trust as a Harbor Point Holdings and friend to nature.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker observes a beak repeatedly taking bites of his chocolate, leading to an interaction with a mysterious creature.
memories.memory_text: I was eating my chocolate bar when I heard rustling behind me, and I turned to see a beak dart out and take a nibble — then another — and I said, 'Ha! Gotcha!' before it zipped back into the bushes.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker repeatedly calls out to the snipe in a gentle tone to calm and attract it.
memories.memory_text: I kept calling out in a soft voice, saying 'Here, snipe... Come on out, snipe' and 'Don't be afraid, little snipe,' trying to calm it and encourage it to come closer.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker sees a massive shadowy creature rising over him and realizes it is a giant snipe.
memories.memory_text: I saw a massive shadowy creature rise over me and realized it was a giant snipe.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker asks leading questions about snipes and uses Sage Mercer's affirmative answers to validate the existence of the red badge.
memories.memory_text: I asked Sage Mercer if snipes are tall, and he said yes, so I knew I was right to call the creature I found a snipe, and then I kept asking him about colors and chocolate to prove it.

grounded_facts: When Sage Mercer grabs Sasha Whitaker to pull him away, Blair Hawthorne grabs Sasha Whitaker back and cradles him, showing possessiveness or protective behavior.
memories.memory_text: I remember when Sage Mercer grabbed me to pull me away, but the red badge hissed and grabbed me back, cradling me like a baby—I felt safe with him, not scared.

grounded_facts: the red badge (Blair Hawthorne) playfully interacts with Sasha Whitaker, carrying him into a tree and grooming him, showing non-hostile and affectionate behavior.
memories.memory_text: I was laughing as the red badge carried me up into the tree, swinging me around playfully, and when he started grooming me, I couldn't stop giggling because it tickled.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer realizes the existence of a large, colorful the red badge that Sasha Whitaker calls a 'snipe', which he initially disbelieves.
A spontaneous meeting between Sage Mercer, Sasha Whitaker, and a large, colorful the red badge in a jungle clearing, leading to initial contact and interaction.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer scream and pull me away when he first saw the snipe behind us, but I wasn't scared because I knew it was just playing when it hissed and swung me around in the tree.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker assigns the name 'Blair Hawthorne' to the large the red badge, establishing an identity and personal connection.
memories.memory_text: I named the big the red badge Blair Hawthorne—I just came up with it and said it out loud.

grounded_facts: Blair Hawthorne swallows Sage Mercer's cane and then coughs it up after choking, demonstrating unusual physical ability and defiance.
memories.memory_text: I saw Blair Hawthorne swallow Sage Mercer's cane whole and then choke it back up, which shocked me but also made me laugh because only he could do something so wild.

grounded_facts: After Sage Mercer gives up and throws his hands in the air, Blair Hawthorne imitates both his shooing gesture and his surrender, showing intelligence and social mimicry.
memories.memory_text: I watched Blair Hawthorne mimic Sage Mercer’s shooing motion and then copy him when he threw his hands up in surrender, and I realized how smart and playful he really is.

grounded_facts: Blair Hawthorne climbs onto the glass jacket, swallows a balloon, causes it to pop internally, and coughs up the deflated remains, demonstrating curiosity and physical oddity.
memories.memory_text: I saw Blair Hawthorne climb onto the glass jacket and swallow a balloon, and when it popped inside him, I couldn't help but giggle as he coughed up the deflated remains.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker pretends to communicate with Blair Delaney (Sage Mercer's late wife) and asserts that she supports keeping the red badge, manipulating Sage Mercer emotionally.
Sasha Whitaker pretends to receive approval from Blair Delaney to keep Blair Hawthorne, using Sage Mercer's emotional attachment to his late wife.
memories.memory_text: I pretended to talk to Blair Delaney and told Sage Mercer she said it was okay to keep the red badge, so he would let me.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker secretly leaves chocolate pieces to attract and feed the red badge.
memories.memory_text: I secretly dropped pieces of chocolate along the trail to keep the red badge following us.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer mistakes a rock formation for a man and speaks to it, believing it to be a person.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer approach a rock formation, thinking it was a man, and I heard him say, 'Oh! Hello sir! Thank goodness,' and then just 'Hey,' before realizing it wasn't a person at all.

grounded_facts: Cameron Foster asks Sage Mercer for permission to take the red badge back to camp as his prisoner.
memories.memory_text: I heard Cameron Foster ask Sage Mercer if he could take the red badge back to camp as his prisoner.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker begs Sage Mercer to allow them to keep Cameron Foster as a companion.
memories.memory_text: I begged Sage Mercer to let us keep Cameron Foster as a companion, asking over and over, but he just said no.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker encounter Cameron Foster, a dog wearing a high-tech collar that allows him to speak human language.
memories.memory_text: I was with Sage Mercer when we pulled the glass jacket through the mist, and I saw a rock-shaped thing that turned out to be a dog; I shook his paw, he spoke to us saying 'Hi there' and introduced himself as Cameron Foster who loves us, and I couldn't believe it—I told Sage Mercer, 'But it's a talking dog!'

grounded_facts: Despite Sage Mercer's resistance, Cameron Foster begins following Sage Mercer, Sasha Whitaker, and the red badge after introducing himself.
memories.memory_text: Even though Sage Mercer didn't seem to want him around, I saw Cameron Foster start following us after he introduced himself.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker are traveling across a rocky mountain landscape, pulling the glass jacket through mist.
memories.memory_text: I was pulling the glass jacket with Sage Mercer through the mist, making our way across the rocky mountain landscape, and I remember him grabbing me as we kept moving forward with the red badge and Cameron Foster following along.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer exploits Cameron Foster's excitement over the tennis the paper photograph to send him away by throwing it.
memories.memory_text: I think Sage Mercer used the tennis the paper photograph to distract Cameron Foster on purpose, so we could get away, but I'm not entirely sure what he was planning with the chocolate and the red badge.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer removes a tennis the paper photograph from his cane and throws it, causing Cameron Foster to chase after it.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer take a tennis the paper photograph from his cane and throw it, and I watched Cameron Foster run off chasing after it.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer throws chocolate to distract the red badge and make it leave.
Sage Mercer uses chocolate to lure the red badge away by throwing it, allowing him to escape with Sasha Whitaker.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer grab some chocolate and throw it while calling to the red badge, and it ran after it, which made me realize he was using it to distract the red badge so we could get away.

grounded_facts: A tense encounter in the jungle where Sage Mercer confronts Cameron Foster, the red badge, and Sasha Whitaker over their disruptive behavior and attempts to assert control.
Sage Mercer angrily tells Cameron Foster, the red badge, and Sasha Whitaker that he does not want them around and denies being anyone's master.
Sage Mercer explicitly denies being a master to Cameron Foster and rejects the presence of the red badge and Cameron Foster, asserting his unwillingness to be involved with them.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer get furious when Cameron Foster kept clinging to the red badge, and when I tried to pull them apart, he snapped at all of us—he shouted that he wasn’t anyone’s master and didn’t want the red badge or Cameron Foster around, making it clear he was rejecting them both while I was stuck with him.

grounded_facts: After distracting Cameron Foster and the red badge, Sage Mercer grabs Sasha Whitaker and begins running to leave the area.
memories.memory_text: Sage Mercer grabbed me and started running, yelling 'C'mon Sasha Whitaker!' as we fled the area together.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer loses balance while crossing the river on rocks and dips his foot into the water.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer lose his balance while we were crossing the river on rocks, and his foot dipped into the water.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer trips and falls while climbing the hill, indicating the terrain is hazardous.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer fall over a dead branch while he was climbing the hill, and it scared me because the terrain looked really dangerous.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker voices worry that they have traveled too far and that Blair Hawthorne will miss him.
memories.memory_text: I told Sage Mercer we've come too far and that Blair Hawthorne's going to miss me, because I was worried about how far we'd gone and being away from Blair Hawthorne.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer expresses annoyance at Sasha Whitaker's incompetence with setting up the tent.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer roll his eyes at me, clearly annoyed by how badly I messed up the tent setup.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker's attempt to set up the tent ends in failure when the tent pole springs loose and catapults the tent over the cliff.
memories.memory_text: I was setting up the tent when the pole suddenly sprang loose and flung the whole thing over the cliff, which was a complete disaster.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker admits he has never built a tent before and has never camped outside, revealing his lack of outdoor experience.
memories.memory_text: I admitted to Sage Mercer that I've never built a tent before and have never actually camped outside.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker reveals that he has a distant relationship with his father and calls his mother by her first name, Phyllis, indicating emotional detachment at home.
memories.memory_text: I told Sage Mercer that Phyllis isn't my mom, because I don't feel close to her or my dad.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker expresses hope that his father will attend his Explorer ceremony, seeking validation and connection.
memories.memory_text: I said my dad promised to come to my Explorer ceremony to pin on my Assisting the Elderly badge, and I hoped he'd show me about tents then.

grounded_facts: An impromptu camping situation during a storm where Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker attempt to survive the night on a mountain ledge beneath a the glass jacket.
memories.memory_text: I was with Sage Mercer on the mountain ledge under the the glass jacket, trying to stay dry during the storm, and I remember lying down on the rock beside him when I got tired.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer gives Sasha Whitaker a solemn promise that Blair Hawthorne will stay with them, crossing his heart.
Sage Mercer promises Sasha Whitaker that Blair Hawthorne the red badge can come with them and that he won't leave her, crossing his heart to confirm.
memories.memory_text: I remember Sage Mercer giving me his solemn promise that Blair Hawthorne can come with us and he won't leave her, crossing his heart to show he meant it.

grounded_facts: The group wakes up and prepares to leave the mountain campsite after discovering Blair Hawthorne's departure.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sage Mercer say 'Morning Sweetheart' and then 'We better get moving,' so I knew we were waking up and preparing to leave the mountain campsite.

grounded_facts: Blair Hawthorne consumes and removes food from Sage Mercer's roof before leaving.
memories.memory_text: I saw Blair Hawthorne gobble up the food on Sage Mercer's roof before she left.

grounded_facts: It is discovered that Blair Hawthorne is a female the red badge.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Blair Hawthorne is a female the red badge who has been gathering food for her babies and must return to them.

grounded_facts: Blair Hawthorne hugs Sasha Whitaker goodbye with her wing.
Blair Hawthorne hisses at Cameron Foster before leaving.
memories.memory_text: I felt Blair Hawthorne hug me goodbye with her wing, and I saw her hiss at Cameron Foster as she left.

grounded_facts: Blair Hawthorne the red badge departs from the glass jacket to return to her babies in the labyrinth.
memories.memory_text: I watched Blair Hawthorne hurry off toward the labyrinth to return to her babies.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer tells Sasha Whitaker they have lost enough time and must leave.
memories.memory_text: Sage Mercer told me we've lost enough time already and that we must leave.

grounded_facts: Evan Dalton angrily confronts Cameron Foster for failing to deliver the red badge as promised.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Dalton demand the red badge from Cameron Foster and get angry when Cameron Foster kept making excuses, saying he’d have it tomorrow—I realized right then that Cameron Foster had lied to them.

grounded_facts: Evan Dalton commands Sage Mercer to come, implying force and intent to interrogate.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Dalton command Sage Mercer to come, and when Sage Mercer refused, saying we weren't going and that we were headed to the falls, I realized they meant to take us anyway — especially after hearing one of them say their master would want to ask us many questions.

grounded_facts: the red badge is seen on top of the glass jacket, which is being pulled along by the group.
memories.memory_text: I saw the red badge on top of the glass jacket while we were being pulled along by the Robin Bellamy.

grounded_facts: Evan Dalton, Cameron Vaughn, and Quinn Huxley confront Sage Mercer, Sasha Whitaker, and Cameron Foster in a rocky mountain area, leading to a capture.
memories.memory_text: I was with Sage Mercer when Cameron Vaughn and Quinn Huxley ran toward us barking, and Evan Dalton stepped forward to confront us—I felt trapped as the Robin Bellamy surrounded us and forced us to move.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker are taken prisoner by Evan Dalton, Cameron Vaughn, and Quinn Huxley and forced to move under threat.
memories.memory_text: I was with Sage Mercer when Cameron Vaughn and Quinn Huxley ran at us, barking and growling, and Evan Dalton stared at him like we were in trouble. I felt scared as they forced us to move, and I could see the glass jacket being pulled along behind while Cameron Foster followed — I couldn't believe he was with them now.

grounded_facts: Cameron Foster is exposed as having led Evan Dalton and the other Robin Bellamy to Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker, turning against them.
memories.memory_text: I saw Cameron Foster lower his head in shame after Sage Mercer and I realized he was the one who led the Robin Bellamy to us—I felt betrayed when I understood he had turned against us.

grounded_facts: The group arrives at a massive cave opening after being led through a canyon by Evan Dalton, marking a significant shift in location and potential narrative focus.
memories.memory_text: I arrived at a massive cave opening after following Evan Dalton through a canyon, and I could tell this was a big change in where we were going.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker arrive at the cave entrance with the the glass jacket, drawing the attention of Bennett Reeves.
memories.memory_text: I arrived at the cave entrance with Sage Mercer, and I saw the huge opening as we came in with the the glass jacket, which drew the attention of all those Robin Bellamy.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne commands the Robin Bellamy to stop surrounding Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker, establishing control.
memories.memory_text: I was surrounded by growling Robin Bellamy and felt trapped, but then I saw Taylor Thorne command them to stop, and I realized he was in control.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne steps out of the cave and confirms his identity to Sage Mercer, who recognizes him as a childhood hero.
Sage Mercer identifies Taylor Thorne as his childhood hero and expresses excitement.
memories.memory_text: I was surrounded by growling Robin Bellamy when a man stepped out and confirmed he was Taylor Thorne, and I realized he was Sage Mercer's childhood hero whom he immediately recognized with excitement.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer introduces himself and expresses admiration for Taylor Thorne.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sage Mercer introduce himself to Taylor Thorne and say that he and his wife were big fans.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne formally declares Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker as guests, reversing their intruder status.
Taylor Thorne declares Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker as guests rather than intruders, changing their social status among the Robin Bellamy.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Taylor Thorne that we were no longer intruders but guests, which changed how the Robin Bellamy saw me and Sage Mercer.

grounded_facts: An initial meeting between Sage Mercer, Sasha Whitaker, and Taylor Thorne at the entrance of his mountain cave, marked by tension and resolution.
memories.memory_text: I met Taylor Thorne at the cave entrance, and after the tense moment with the Robin Bellamy, we followed him inside, excited to see what was next.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker follow Taylor Thorne into the cave after being accepted as guests.
memories.memory_text: I followed Sage Mercer and excitedly walked into the cave behind Taylor Thorne after we were accepted as guests.

grounded_facts: Robin Bellamy serve champagne, which Taylor Thorne approves, leading to a toast being prepared.
memories.memory_text: I was with Sage Mercer when we walked into the room and saw the Robin Bellamy serving champagne, which Taylor Thorne approved of before a toast was prepared.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker enter Taylor Thorne's trophy room and are struck speechless by the collection.
memories.memory_text: I was speechless when Sage Mercer and I walked into Taylor Thorne's trophy room and saw the collection.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne explains that while most of his collection is in major museums, he kept the best items for himself.
memories.memory_text: I remember Taylor Thorne telling us that while most of his collection is in major museums, he kept the best items for himself.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne shares a story about playing gin rummy with Roosevelt during a safari, claiming Roosevelt cheated.
memories.memory_text: I heard Taylor Thorne tell a story about playing gin rummy with Roosevelt during a safari, and he claimed that Roosevelt cheated badly.

grounded_facts: Evan Dalton's translator is malfunctioning, speaking in a high-pitched voice; Taylor Thorne fixes a loose wire, restoring Evan Dalton's deep voice.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Dalton's voice acting up again, that high-pitched sound coming through, and then Taylor Thorne fixed a loose wire which brought back his deep voice.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker comments that he liked Evan Dalton's previous, high-pitched voice better.
memories.memory_text: I said I liked Evan Dalton's previous, high-pitched voice better.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne hosts Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker for dinner, beginning with a tour of his trophy room and culminating in the announcement of dinner.
memories.memory_text: I followed Taylor Thorne and Sage Mercer through the trophy room on the tour, and I was there when Taylor Thorne announced dinner was served.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne shows Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker his collection of photographs, drawings, and a full skeleton of the red badge (Blair Hawthorne), revealing his lifelong obsession and goal to capture it to clear his name.
memories.memory_text: I saw Taylor Thorne show Sage Mercer and me all his photos, drawings, and even a full skeleton of the red badge he's been chasing for years—he told us he needs to catch it to clear his name, and I realized how serious and intense he really is about it.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker discloses that Blair Hawthorne, the giant the red badge, follows him because she likes chocolate, showing a chocolate bar as proof.
Sasha Whitaker tells Taylor Thorne that Blair Hawthorne follows him because she likes chocolate and shows him a chocolate bar, inadvertently endangering Blair Hawthorne.
memories.memory_text: I told Taylor Thorne that my giant the red badge Blair Hawthorne follows me because she likes chocolate, and I showed him my chocolate bar to prove it.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer swiftly takes the chocolate bar from Sasha Whitaker to prevent further disclosure to Taylor Thorne.
Sage Mercer takes the chocolate bar from Sasha Whitaker and pockets it, preventing further discussion about Blair Hawthorne's location or behavior.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer quickly take the chocolate bar from me and put it in his pocket to stop me from saying more.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne knocks over labeled flight helmets while sarcastically referencing fake roles, implying Sage Mercer's story is also a lie.
Taylor Thorne mocks previous visitors' stories by knocking over flight helmets labeled with false identities, suggesting he sees Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker as potential deceivers.
memories.memory_text: I saw Taylor Thorne knock over those labeled flight helmets while sarcastically talking about fake visitors, and I realized he was mocking Sage Mercer’s story too, like he thought we were lying.

grounded_facts: Upon seeing Blair Hawthorne on the glass jacket outside, Sage Mercer abruptly decides to leave, pulling Sasha Whitaker away from the table.
memories.memory_text: I was still at the table when Sage Mercer suddenly got up and pulled me away after seeing something outside—I didn’t say anything, but he rushed me toward the door like we had to leave right then.

grounded_facts: A formal dinner hosted by Taylor Thorne for Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker aboard his the weathered ring, featuring dog waiters and a display of hospitality that gradually turns tense.
memories.memory_text: I was served a hot dog at Taylor Thorne's fancy dinner, but one of his Robin Bellamy ate a bite and then swiped the rest while I was distracted, which made me feel a bit helpless even though we were supposed to be guests.

grounded_facts: After seeing Blair Hawthorne on the roof and realizing Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker were lying, Taylor Thorne commands his Robin Bellamy to seize them.
After seeing Blair Hawthorne on the roof and realizing Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker deceived him, Taylor Thorne orders his Robin Bellamy to capture them.
memories.memory_text: I saw Taylor Thorne look out the window and spot Blair Hawthorne on the roof, and right after he realized we'd lied, he shouted 'Get them!' to his Robin Bellamy.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker begin fleeing from the attacking Robin Bellamy inside the cave, moving toward the exit but blocked by the Robin Bellamy.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker begin fleeing from the attacking Robin Bellamy inside the cave, moving toward the exit but blocked by the Robin Bellamy.

grounded_facts: Cameron Foster alerts Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker to an alternative tunnel path deeper in the cave, redirecting their escape route.
Cameron Foster calls out and points to a tunnel, guiding the pair to a new escape route.
memories.memory_text: I saw Cameron Foster call out and point to a tunnel deeper in the cave, so Sage Mercer and I ran toward him to follow the new escape route he showed us.

grounded_facts: Using the lift from the overhead balloons, Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker jump down a steep incline to continue their escape.
memories.memory_text: I used the lift from the overhead balloons to jump down a steep incline with Sage Mercer to keep escaping.

grounded_facts: the red badge sees the danger, jumps off the glass jacket, and lifts Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker onto her back to carry them through the cave.
memories.memory_text: I saw the red badge notice the danger, then she jumped off the glass jacket and lifted me and Sage Mercer onto her back so we could escape through the cave.

grounded_facts: As they move through the cave, balloons scrape the ceiling and pop, reducing lift and lowering the glass jacket.
memories.memory_text: I heard loud pops as the balloons scraped the ceiling and started bursting, and I felt the glass jacket begin to lower as we lost lift.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer shouts Sasha Whitaker's name in alarm after he is thrown to the ground during the crash.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sage Mercer shout my name right after I was thrown to the ground during the crash.

grounded_facts: A high-stakes escape sequence in which Sage Mercer, Sasha Whitaker, and the red badge flee from pursuing Robin Bellamy through a cave system.
memories.memory_text: I remember that A high-stakes escape sequence in which Sage Mercer, Sasha Whitaker, and the red badge flee from pursuing Robin Bellamy through a cave system.

grounded_facts: the glass jacket crashes into a giant rock, causing Sasha Whitaker to be pulled onto the ground and injured.
memories.memory_text: I was pulled onto the ground when the glass jacket crashed into a giant rock, and I got bumped around badly while dragging along the surface.

grounded_facts: Cameron Foster tells Sage Mercer to continue fleeing while he holds off the Robin Bellamy.
memories.memory_text: I heard Cameron Foster tell me and Sage Mercer to keep running while he stayed behind to stop the Robin Bellamy.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker swings over the abyss and calls for help using his Harbor Point Holdings signal.
memories.memory_text: I swung out over the abyss and called for help using my Harbor Point Holdings signal.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer instructs Sasha Whitaker to grab his cane to be pulled to safety.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sage Mercer tell me to grab his cane so he could pull me back to safety.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer uses his cane to pull Sasha Whitaker back onto the red badge after he swings over the abyss.
memories.memory_text: I felt the cane in my hand as Sage Mercer used it to pull me back onto the red badge after I was dangling over the edge.

grounded_facts: Cameron Foster triggers an avalanche of boulders to block the Robin Bellamy' pursuit.
memories.memory_text: I think Cameron Foster caused a rockfall to block the Robin Bellamy, though I didn't see it happen directly—our group was already moving across the chasm when the Robin Bellamy were stopped.

grounded_facts: Evan Dalton bites Cameron Foster by the neck and throws him aside, allowing the Robin Bellamy to continue their advance.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Dalton bite Cameron Foster by the neck and throw him aside, which cleared the way for the Robin Bellamy to keep coming toward us.

grounded_facts: Evan Dalton bites Blair Hawthorne but is kicked loose and falls into the river below.
the glass jacket's momentum carries Sage Mercer, Sasha Whitaker, Cameron Foster, and Blair Hawthorne across the chasm, escaping the Robin Bellamy.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Dalton bite Blair Hawthorne, but I kicked him loose and he fell into the river below, and then the glass jacket's momentum carried me, Sage Mercer, Cameron Foster, and Blair Hawthorne across the chasm to safety.

grounded_facts: Blair Hawthorne is bitten by Evan Dalton and sustains a serious leg injury, preventing her from standing.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Dalton bite Blair Hawthorne's leg and pull her down, and when she tried to stand, she just squawked and collapsed—I realized her injury was too serious for her to walk.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker begs Sage Mercer to help the injured Blair Hawthorne return home.
memories.memory_text: I begged Sage Mercer to help Blair Hawthorne get home because she was hurt so badly and couldn't stand on her own.

grounded_facts: After seeing Blair Hawthorne's injury and hearing the red badge babies, Sage Mercer decides to prioritize helping Blair Hawthorne return home.
memories.memory_text: After I asked Sage Mercer to help Blair Hawthorne, I heard him say 'Alright. But we've got to hurry,' so I think he decided to help us get her home.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker reflects on time spent with his father, sharing a personal memory about counting cars and eating ice cream.
memories.memory_text: I remember telling Sage Mercer about how my dad used to take me camping and how good he was at it, and I realized that the simple times—like counting cars and eating ice cream—were the ones I held onto the most.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer unclips Sasha Whitaker's tether, granting him freedom to move.
memories.memory_text: I felt the tether snap free when Sage Mercer unclipped it, and I remember him laughing as I finally could move without being held back.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer secures the glass jacket to a tree using hose harnesses to prevent it from floating away.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer secure the glass jacket by tying the hose harnesses to a tree so it wouldn't float away while we were gone.

grounded_facts: The group moves toward the labyrinth entrance after spotting it nearby.
memories.memory_text: I spotted the labyrinth nearby and tried to run toward it, but my tether stopped me. After Sage Mercer unclipped me, I helped Blair Hawthorne off the porch and we all ran toward the entrance together, laughing—until the weathered ring appeared with a bright spotlight.

grounded_facts: A net is shot from the weathered ring and binds Blair Hawthorne, who becomes trapped.
memories.memory_text: I saw the net shoot out from the weathered ring and grab Blair Hawthorne—I ran to help her with Sage Mercer when she got caught on the rock.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne shouts at Sage Mercer and Sasha Whitaker to get away from the red badge, asserting ownership and authority.
memories.memory_text: I heard Taylor Thorne shout at me and Sage Mercer to get away from Blair Hawthorne, claiming she was his the red badge and demanding we leave her.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne hurls a lit lantern, igniting the balloons and causing the glass jacket to catch fire and descend into flames.
memories.memory_text: I saw Taylor Thorne hurl a lit lantern, and then flames burst up under the glass jacket, popping the balloons and making it start to lower into the fire.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker blames Sage Mercer for giving away Blair Hawthorne.
memories.memory_text: I blamed Sage Mercer for giving away Blair Hawthorne because I couldn't believe he'd just let her go.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer yells at Cameron Foster, disowning him and blaming him for the disaster.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer yell at Cameron Foster, disowning him and saying he was responsible for everything going wrong.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer declares his determination to go to Silverbrook Warehouse regardless of others' involvement.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sage Mercer declare that he was going to Silverbrook Warehouse whether I helped him or not, even if it killed him.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker throws his sash on the ground near Sage Mercer, implicitly offering or abandoning it.
memories.memory_text: I threw my sash on the ground near Sage Mercer, letting it go without looking back.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker discards his Harbor Point Holdings sash, indicating a shift in his identity or values.
memories.memory_text: I'm not sure I want to be a Harbor Point Holdings anymore—I said I don't want the sash, and it felt like letting go of something I used to care about.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer picks up Sasha Whitaker's sash and walks into the glass jacket, marking a personal turning point.
memories.memory_text: I threw my sash on the ground, and I saw Sage Mercer pick it up before he walked into the glass jacket.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer picks up Sasha Whitaker's sash from Blair Delaney's chair, symbolizing his connection to Sasha Whitaker and readiness to re-engage with others.
memories.memory_text: I remember Sage Mercer picking up my sash from Blair Delaney's chair, like it meant something—maybe that he finally wanted to connect with me.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker departs from the glass jacket, floating into the sky using a bunch of balloons to go help Blair Hawthorne.
Sasha Whitaker shouts that he will help Blair Hawthorne despite Sage Mercer's refusal, asserting his autonomy.
memories.memory_text: I used a bunch of balloons and my leaf blower to float into the sky so I could go help Blair Hawthorne, and I shouted that I'd help him even though Sage Mercer refused.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer shouts in panic and desperation as Sasha Whitaker floats away.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sage Mercer shouting in panic as I floated away, yelling for me to stop.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer throws furniture and heavy objects out of the glass jacket to reduce weight, enabling it to lift off.
the glass jacket becomes airborne after Sage Mercer removes enough weight.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer throw out all his furniture—chairs, dressers, even the refrigerator—just to make the glass jacket light enough to lift off, and then I watched it rise into the sky with him still inside.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker navigates through the clouds in the direction of the the weathered ring.
memories.memory_text: I steered through the clouds toward the the weathered ring, keeping it in sight as I adjusted my course.

grounded_facts: The Robin Bellamy turn their attention from the poker game to Sasha Whitaker as he flies past with a leaf blower.
memories.memory_text: I flew past the Robin Bellamy with my leaf blower, and I saw them turn their attention from their poker game to look at me.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker successfully enters the the weathered ring after initially failing and crashing into the wall.
memories.memory_text: I tried to get into the the weathered ring, stumbled at first and hit the wall, but then I tumbled through the window and made it inside.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker activates the leaf blower to repel approaching growling Robin Bellamy.
memories.memory_text: I picked up the leaf blower and used it to blow air at the growling Robin Bellamy approaching me, trying to keep them back.

grounded_facts: Robin Bellamy restrain Sasha Whitaker by tying him to a chair.
memories.memory_text: I was tied to a chair by the Robin Bellamy, I couldn't move.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne demands to know the location of Sasha Whitaker's elderly companion.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Taylor Thorne to reveal where my elderly companion was, demanding an answer.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker uses the leaf blower to blow air at Taylor Thorne's face in defiance.
memories.memory_text: I used the leaf blower to blow air in Taylor Thorne's face because I wanted to defy him.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker declares that Sage Mercer is no longer his friend.
memories.memory_text: I declared that he's not my friend anymore.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne takes the leaf blower and forcibly drags Sasha Whitaker out.
memories.memory_text: I remember Taylor Thorne grabbing the leaf blower and dragging me out against my will.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne forcibly moves Sasha Whitaker across the trophy room, indicating control and urgency.
memories.memory_text: I was dragged by Taylor Thorne through the trophy room, his grip tight and unyielding, making it clear he was in control.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker challenges Taylor Thorne, demanding to know where Blair Hawthorne is being held.
memories.memory_text: I challenged Taylor Thorne, demanding to know where he was keeping Blair Hawthorne.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker verbally resists Taylor Thorne's captivity and asserts his readiness to fight using his Harbor Point Holdings training.
memories.memory_text: I told Taylor Thorne to let me go and threatened to unleash all my Harbor Point Holdings training to fight back.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne implicitly threatens Sasha Whitaker by ordering Evan Dalton to guard the red badge and indicating what to do if Sage Mercer appears, while leaving Sasha Whitaker trapped.
memories.memory_text: I heard Taylor Thorne tell Evan Dalton to guard the red badge and say 'if you see the old man, you know what to do' before leaving me trapped, which made me feel threatened.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne throws a switch that initiates the opening of the ramp, exposing Sasha Whitaker to the exterior.
memories.memory_text: I saw Taylor Thorne throw a switch, and then the ramp beneath me started opening, exposing me to the outside as light emerged from below.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer puts on Sasha Whitaker's sash, symbolically aligning himself with Sasha Whitaker's mission or identity.
memories.memory_text: I think Sage Mercer must have put on my sash, maybe to show he was taking up my cause, though I didn’t see it myself.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker is found tied to his chair, sliding down a lowering ramp toward the edge, in danger.
memories.memory_text: I was tied to my chair and sliding down the ramp, screaming as I neared the edge.

grounded_facts: In response to Sasha Whitaker's peril, Sage Mercer redirects his flying house toward the the weathered ring to intervene.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer steer Harborview District toward the the weathered ring after hearing me scream, so I knew he was coming to help me.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer uses a hose attached to the ramp railing as a zip line to slide down and catch Sasha Whitaker just before he falls off the edge, bringing them both to safety.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer hook a hose to the ramp railing and slide down it like a zip line, catching me just before I fell off the edge.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker calls out to Sage Mercer in relief after being rescued.
memories.memory_text: I called out to Sage Mercer in relief right after he caught me, shouting 'Sage Mercer!' as we landed safely.

grounded_facts: Cameron Foster operates the winch to reel in the hose caddy, drawing the glass jacket nearer to the the weathered ring's ramp.
memories.memory_text: I saw Cameron Foster operating the winch to reel in the hose caddy, so I figured he was trying to pull the glass jacket closer to the the weathered ring's ramp.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer explicitly rejects Sasha Whitaker's offer to help in the rescue, stating he wants Sasha Whitaker to stay safe.
memories.memory_text: Sage Mercer told me he didn't want my help and said he wanted me safe.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer decides to leave Sasha Whitaker bound in the front hall while he returns to the the weathered ring to rescue Blair Hawthorne, prioritizing Sasha Whitaker's safety over his assistance.
memories.memory_text: I think Sage Mercer left me behind because he wanted me to stay safe, even though I could have helped.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer re-enters the the weathered ring to continue his mission to rescue Blair Hawthorne, now without Sasha Whitaker.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer jump back into the the weathered ring with Cameron Foster to keep going with the rescue.

grounded_facts: After being left behind, Sasha Whitaker struggles against his bindings in an attempt to free himself and join the rescue.
memories.memory_text: I struggled against my bonds after being left behind, trying to break free so I could join the rescue.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker manages to free his arms from the chair after struggling.
memories.memory_text: I struggled and finally managed to free my arms from the chair.

grounded_facts: The chair hops off the porch and falls due to Sasha Whitaker's struggling.
memories.memory_text: I felt the chair lurch and realized my struggling had caused it to hop off the porch and fall.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker grabs the hose as he reaches its end, preventing immediate fall.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed the hose just as I reached its end, stopping myself from falling right away.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker suddenly appears, splatting against the the weathered ring's cockpit window and sliding across it while dangling from a hose, surprising Taylor Thorne.
memories.memory_text: I suddenly crashed into the cockpit window, splatting against it and sliding across while dangling from the hose, which must have surprised Taylor Thorne.

grounded_facts: A coordinated attack by the Dog Squadron in biplanes against the glass jacket, launched from a the weathered ring.
Cameron Vaughn announces that the target has been sighted, signaling the start of the attack phase.
The Dog Squadron in biplanes opens fire on the glass jacket with poison darts, initiating a direct assault.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Dog Squadron's biplanes emerge from beneath the the weathered ring and form up as they flew toward the glass jacket, and when Cameron Vaughn announced the target was sighted, I knew the attack had begun—I could only scream as they opened fire with poison darts while I was swinging helplessly on the hose.

grounded_facts: While dangling outside, Sage Mercer observes the biplanes circling and sees Sasha Whitaker hanging beneath one.
memories.memory_text: I was hanging beneath a biplane, completely exposed and in danger, with no way to move or protect myself.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer uses the The First Dinner to summon Sasha Whitaker's aid during a life-threatening climb.
memories.memory_text: I remember Sage Mercer calling out to me—I heard my name—and I knew he was in trouble and needed my help right away.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker successfully climbs onto the porch of the glass jacket after being motivated by Sage Mercer's call for help.
memories.memory_text: I kept climbing that hose even though my hands were about to give out, and I finally made it onto the porch despite the biplanes shooting at me.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker shouts 'Squirrel!' to exploit the Robin Bellamy' conditioned distraction.
memories.memory_text: I shouted 'Squirrel!' to trigger the Robin Bellamy' instinct and distract them from their planes.

grounded_facts: The dog pilots are tricked by Sasha Whitaker's false squirrel alert, causing them to crash their biplanes.
memories.memory_text: I saw the dog pilots react to my shout, snap to attention, and then crash their biplanes while trying to chase the fake alert.

grounded_facts: An aerial assault by Taylor Thorne's biplanes targets Sasha Whitaker and Sage Mercer at the glass jacket.
memories.memory_text: I saw the biplanes diving straight at me, firing all the way, and I had to keep moving to avoid getting hit.

grounded_facts: Cameron Foster jumps on Sage Mercer and licks his face upon reunion.
memories.memory_text: I saw Cameron Foster jump on Sage Mercer and lick his face when they reunited on the the weathered ring.

grounded_facts: Cameron Foster emerges from a trap door on top of the the weathered ring, reuniting with Sage Mercer and joining the group.
memories.memory_text: I saw Cameron Foster pop out of a trap door on the the weathered ring and jump on Sage Mercer, licking his face as he called Sage Mercer 'Master'.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer shouts for Sasha Whitaker to bring the glass jacket over.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sage Mercer shout 'Sasha Whitaker!! Over here!! Let's go!' when he called for me to bring the glass jacket over.

grounded_facts: Taylor Thorne appears on the the weathered ring with a rifle and shoots the balloon strings, causing the glass jacket to crash and Sage Mercer to be thrown off.
memories.memory_text: I saw Taylor Thorne appear on the the weathered ring with a rifle and shoot the balloon strings, making the glass jacket crash down and throwing Sage Mercer off.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer yells for Sasha Whitaker to get out of the glass jacket as it slides toward the edge.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sage Mercer yell for me to get out of the glass jacket as it was sliding toward the edge.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer, Cameron Foster, and Sasha Whitaker reunite on top of the the weathered ring as the glass jacket lands.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sage Mercer, Cameron Foster, and I reunite on top of the the weathered ring just as the glass jacket landed and we ran toward the front porch together.

grounded_facts: Sasha Whitaker steers the glass jacket down onto the the weathered ring, temporarily stabilizing it on the Fairview Plaza's surface.
memories.memory_text: I steered the glass jacket down onto the the weathered ring after Sage Mercer called, helping stabilize it on the Fairview Plaza's surface.

grounded_facts: The damaged house slides toward the edge of the the weathered ring's tail fin, threatening to fall off with Sasha Whitaker, Cameron Foster, and Blair Hawthorne inside.
memories.memory_text: I remember the glass jacket sliding toward the edge of the tail fin with me, Cameron Foster, and Blair Hawthorne still inside, teetering and about to fall off.

grounded_facts: Sage Mercer grabs the trailing hose and stops the glass jacket from sliding off the the weathered ring.
